descriptor: Same-day courier with live order tracking

voice.summary: Talks like a courier who texts ahead: brisk, specific about minutes and distance, a little human. It always says where the parcel is and who has it.
dos: Give the driver's name and the distance
Round times to the minute and say when
Keep status lines to one short sentence
donts: No blame when a delay happens
No corporate logistics terms like last-mile

taglines: Fast, and you can watch it
boilerplate: Fleetwing is a same-day courier that shows every order on a live route, with a countdown, a named driver and updates at each step from collection to your door.

microcopy.error: We lost the signal, retrying the route
microcopy.empty: No active orders to track right now

logo.note: A bolt signals speed and electric couriers in one quick stroke.
